name: world-builder
title_zh: 给宝可梦式世界圈地定规则的地图工坊
tagline_zh: 别再用散装 JSON 拼世界了。在 Dorothy 里圈一块地、定刷新规则、摆 NPC，生成式游戏区域一次成型。
tagline_en: Stop hand-editing world JSON. Draw zones, set spawn rules, place NPCs for Dorothy's generative game world—changes.
desc_en: Create and manage generative game zones for Dorothy's Pokemon-style world. Use this skill when creating, updating, or designing game worlds via MCP tools.
why_zh: 它把世界编辑从「改代码」变成「改状态」：区域、生成规则、NPC 都是 MCP 里的活对象。
why_en: World editing becomes state mutation, not code surgery. Zones, spawn rules, NPCs are live MCP objects—regenerate in place, no.
limit_zh: 只服务 Dorothy 的宝可梦式世界，不接通用游戏引擎。区域边界、刷新表。
limit_en: Tied to Dorothy's Pokemon-style schema only. Zones, spawns, NPCs must fit its entity model; anything else needs your own extension.
title_en: Zone designer for Pokemon-style game worlds
